text: Do you restrict access to cardholder data by business need to know?
Does your business use network segmentation to affect the scope of your Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) environment?
Do you perform network security testing?
Do you have firewalls and firewall policies in place? If yes, are these policies at least anually
Are all endpoint laptops that connect directly to production networks centrally managed?
Do you require all employees take security awareness training at least anually?
Do you have a program in place to test employee security awareness at least anually?

Is there a policy or control in place that prevents vendors or employees from using unauthorized personal instant messaging services, personal email accounts, and personal applications on company managed devices with access to the client data? If no, can you please explain which of the controls is not being met?
Do you use configuration management to protect client data?
Do you encrypt client data at rest?
